analysis_boundary: Registered episodes are paired within task, initial state, and joint seed. Task and seed blocks are not iid deployment samples, and query-0 equality does not imply later observations remain equal after modes diverge.

block_robustness.interpretation: Percentile intervals resample registered task-by-seed blocks, not episodes as iid deployment observations.

claim_boundaries: not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
